# Source: Little Plant in Moss, plate one from Flower Studies

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Little Plant in Moss, plate one from Flower Studies
- **Artist / culture:** Theodoor van Hoytema Dutch, 1863-1917
- **Date:** 1898, printed 1917/19
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** lithograph
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 95551
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/95551
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/8814a691-5e04-cf19-ba9c-1d3997acff06/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Flower Study

## Extracted source palette

`#E8E8D8, #484838, #686858, #D8D8B8, #B8B898, #888878, #282828, #A89888`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#25251D`
- `surface`: `#3E3E37`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#E8E8D8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#484838`
- `surface_variant`: `#3E3E37`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#60605A`
- `error`: `#E8E8D8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `14.51:1`, surface `10.13:1`
- Variant contrast: `10.13:1`
- Control contrast: `15.79:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
